title: Drive to Recycle Saturday - Irvine
desc: City of Irvine community recycling event. Bring recyclable materials for a chance to win cash and prizes for IUSD schools.
body: Morning setup opens at 8:30 AM. Drop off paper, plastic, metal, and e-waste at the supervised collection zone. Students from IUSD partner schools will help sort materials and run prize drawings throughout the morning. Parking is limited; carpooling is strongly encouraged. Bring materials bagged and clean.

title: OCWR Free Community Compost Giveaway
desc: Free compost distribution for Orange County residents in celebration of Earth Day.
body: Residents can pick up compost while supplies last. Bring your own bins or bags. This giveaway celebrates Earth Day and promotes soil health with locally produced compost.

title: Huntington Beach Cleanup with Veterans!
desc: Open to anyone. Join veterans and volunteers for a 2.5 hour community cleanup on Huntington Beach.
location: 405 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
body: Doors open at 6:45 AM, cleanup 9:00 to 11:30 AM. Gloves and bags provided. Optional 21+ veteran social afterward. Families, beginners, and dog owners are welcome.

title: LBC Beach Cleanup
desc: Community cleanup at 72nd Place in Long Beach. Food and refreshments provided.
body: 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM. Gloves and trash bags provided. Easy parking. A short beach safety briefing starts at 8:55 AM.

title: Tire Recycling Event (South Gate Park)
desc: Drop off old tires at South Gate Park. Family-friendly, 6 hour event.
body: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Drop off worn-out tires safely and help keep the environment clean. Event staff will check load limits per vehicle.

title: BEACH CLEANUP - Daytona Beach (BEACH SQUAD)
desc: Beach Squad community cleanup at Sun Splash Park, Daytona Beach.
location: Sun Splash Park, Daytona Beach, FL
body: 8:30 AM start. Bring water, sunscreen, and closed-toe shoes. This is part of the ongoing Beach Squad cleanup series.

title: June Trash Cleanup - Tampa
desc: General trash cleanup at Davis Island Boat Ramp.
location: Davis Island Boat Ramp, Tampa, FL
body: Meet at 8:00 AM sharp. Heavy items should not be pulled by hand; alert the site lead for a team lift.

title: Conference House Beach Cleanup
desc: Beach cleanup at Conference House Park parking.
location: Conference House Park, Staten Island, NY / NJ area
body: 10:00 AM start. Meet at Conference House Park parking lot. Bring sturdy shoes and weather-appropriate layers.

title: Large TV & Tire Recycling Event
desc: Free recycling drop-off for TVs and tires from El Paso County Environmental Division.
location: El Paso County Household Hazardous Waste Facility, Colorado Springs, CO
body: 9:00 AM start. No commercial drop-offs. Limit 4 tires per passenger vehicle unless otherwise posted.

title: Logan Square Cleanup with Cleanup Club!
desc: Annual neighborhood cleanup and recycling drive in Logan Square, Chicago.
body: 10:00 AM - 1:00 PM. Bring gloves and enthusiasm. Bags and sanitizer provided. All ages are welcome.
